mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friendships (id, requester_id, addressee_id, status, pair_key, message, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requesterId}, #{addresseeId}, #{status}, #{pairKey}, #{message}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM friendships WHERE requester_id = #{userId} OR addressee_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE friendships SET status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_at = #{acceptedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, u.nickname AS partner_nickname, u.birth_year AS partner_birth_year, u.country AS partner_country, p.photo_key AS partner_photo_key FROM friendships f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.requester_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE f.addressee_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id AS post_id, u.id AS user_id, u.nickname, u.birth_year, u.country, pr.intro, p.published_at, COALESCE(s.likes, 0) AS likes FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN post_stats s ON s.user_id = p.user_id AND s.session_date = p.session_date LEFT JOIN user_profiles pr ON pr.user_id = u.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.session_date = #{sessionDate} AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE friendships SET requester_pinned_at = CASE WHEN requester_id = #{userId} THEN #{at} ELSE requester_pinned_at END, addressee_pinned_at = CASE WHEN addressee_id = #{userId} THEN #{at} ELSE addressee_pinned_at END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (requester_id = #{userId} OR addressee_id = #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friendships WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (requester_id = #{userId} OR addressee_id = #{userId})
